_comment: Faz 24 Görevler dilim-4b (gitops#3486 / #3537) — OpenFGA Layer-2 receive grants for the meeting action assignment notifications (topics meeting.action.assigned / meeting.action.reassigned, platform-backend#1128).
_purpose: notification-orchestrator blocks in-app delivery with BLOCKED_BY_AUTHZ unless `template:<id>#can_receive@subscriber:<id>` resolves; the live model inherits can_receive from the topic (`template.topic: [notification_topic]`, `notification_topic.can_receive: [subscriber]`). This seed binds the two templates to their topics and grants can_receive to the TEST meeting users so an assignment reaches the assignee's inbox (measured 2026-09-03: intent mtg-5b2893c8 accepted, delivery authz_deny).
_scope: test-only bootstrap exception (same discipline as meeting-transcript-tuples.json / ADR-0041 §4). k3d-test, realm platform-test. No production realm tuple is written.
_subject_model: subscriber id == platform users_db numeric id (notification-orchestrator RecipientRef.subscriberId == meeting-service resolveUserId(kcSubject) == /authz/me userId). user:1 = test admin (halildeu), user:4 = Zeynep Nisa Akkılıç (KC 63ea39e5), user:9 = ats-recruiter-persona. Extended 2026-09-03 to every active directory account a tester can pick (2, 3, 12, 21); synthetic personas without a meeting role stay out. Permanent per-user grant: gitops#3541.
_invariants: Wildcard subject (subscriber:*, user:*) YASAK — explicit numeric subscriber ids only
Objects limited to the two meeting action templates and their two topics
Idempotent: duplicate write → HTTP 400 'cannot write a tuple which already exists' treated as OK (per-tuple writes)
Canonical/prod path = permission-service tuple writer (DD-EA-2); automatic per-user grant on module membership is tracked separately (gitops#3541)
_apply_via: scripts/faz24/openfga-meeting-action-notify-seed.sh (host jq + meeting-service pod curl, same as scripts/faz24/openfga-meeting-transcript-seed.sh).
